name: Lily
source:
I was the Demon Lord in a different world. Level 999. The strongest.

...But due to the influence of a mysterious artifact, I turned into a girl. Level 1. Weakest.

The Demon Lord was confident and proud, but after being transformed into a girl, that pride was shattered.

[Translated from the [url=https://kumanomi-soft.amusecraft.com/tenmao/#Character]official website[/url]]
